'''''Family Bonds''''' was a painting available in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. It depicted the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Gender/Legends|his]] family&mdash;[[Parent/Legends|father]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], [[Marriage/Legends|wife]] [[Mallatobuck/Legends|Mallatobuck]], and their son [[Lumpawaroo/Legends|Lumpawarrump]]&mdash;celebrating [[Life Day/Legends|Life Day]] together. The painting depicted each of them wearing ceremonial [[red]] [[Life Day robes/Legends|Life Day robes]] and holding [[blue]] [[Life Day Orb/Legends|Life Day orbs]], wisps of blue and a [[Star/Legends|star]] field present behind them.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
''Family Bonds'' was a painting that appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. It is a recreation of a scene from the end of ''[[The Star Wars Holiday Special]]'' and could be used in a player character's home as decoration. The painting was one of the many rewards that players could earn during the Life Day celebrations of [[2008]] and [[2009]]. It was added to the game with the ''Chapter 11.4'' game update on [[December 16]], [[2008]] and was later made available to players through the game's "rare loot system" on [[October 7]], [[2010]]. The system allowed players to obtain exceedingly rare items from any enemy in the game.<ref name="SWG" />
